sources.title: Lexar PLAY PRO microSDXC Express Card
Lexar PLAY PRO microSDXC Express Card Setup Sheet

claims.evidence: Lexar specifies the product form factor as microSDXC Express; the catalog separates this into microSDXC form factor and SD Express bus.
Lexar identifies the card as microSD Express and specifies PCIe and NVMe interface technologies.

Lexar repeatedly states in the product Key Features and Features sections that PLAY PRO delivers up to 900 MB/s read. The page's specification table separately contains a conflicting 205 MB/s value; this record follows the repeated Express-specific product-feature value.

Lexar repeatedly states in the product Key Features and Features sections that PLAY PRO delivers up to 600 MB/s write. The page's specification table separately contains a conflicting 140 MB/s value; this record follows the repeated Express-specific product-feature value.
Lexar lists a 256GB PLAY PRO microSDXC Express variant.
Lexar's North American ordering information lists LMSXPS0256G-BNNNU for the 256GB card.
Lexar lists a 512GB PLAY PRO microSDXC Express variant.
Lexar's North American ordering information lists LMSXPS0512G-BNNNU for the 512GB card.
Lexar lists a 1TB PLAY PRO microSDXC Express variant.
Lexar's North American ordering information lists LMSXPS0001T-BNNNU for the 1TB card.
